The '''Froz 350 complete gear set''' was a suit of [[Environment suit/Legends|adverse environment gear]] available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The gear set was produced by the [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]] company and sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Froz 350 complete gear set was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].
